chunks: No one shelters the stray except one who is astray.

key_terms.الضَّالَّةَ: A stray or lost animal/property whose owner is absent.
key_terms.الضَّالُّ: One who is astray; here, the one blameworthy for sheltering the stray improperly.

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about sheltering stray property?
ai.summary: This concise prophetic saying condemns giving refuge to lost or unlawfully retained property. It draws a moral parallel between the one who shelters the stray and one who is himself astray, highlighting ethical responsibility in dealing with the property and rights of others.
